item.title: Alibaba, Baidu, Kuaishou Address Mounting AI Costs as Competition Intensifies
item.description: Alibaba Group Holding Ltd., Baidu Inc. and Kuaishou Technology are the next big names in tech that will have to address concerns over the mounting financial costs needed to sustain intense AI competition.

item.title: PBOC Conducts Mid-Month Overnight Reverse Repo for First Time
item.description: China’s central bank injected liquidity through overnight reverse repos on Friday, marking its first such operation in the middle of a month.

item.title: China’s High-Tech Boom Seen Failing to Halt Slowdown of Economy
item.description: China’s economy likely kicked off the second half of 2026 in much the same way it saw out the first, with a booming technology sector failing to make up for an historic investment slump and sluggish consumption.

item.title: Uber and China’s Pony AI to Deploy 2,000 Robotaxis in Europe
item.description: Pony AI Inc. said it plans to deploy more than 2,000 robotaxis across Europe in partnership with Uber Technologies Inc., accelerating the race to commercialize autonomous-mobility in the region.

item.title: Indian Startup Leans on Cancer-Sniffing Dogs and AI for Early Detection
item.description: On a two-acre farm outside Bengaluru in southern India, Billy, Jessie and Banu put on their gear, enter a laboratory packed with samples and clock in for a shift detecting early signs of cancer.

item.title: Thrive Investor Letter Reveals OpenAI-Fueled Growth, Stake Sale
item.description: Thrive Capital’s 2022 early-stage venture capital fund, a $516 million investment vehicle that made early bets on OpenAI, SpaceX and Anduril Industries Inc., has grown to be worth more than $3.7 billion as of the end of June.

item.title: Read Joshua Kushner’s First Formal Thrive Capital Investor Letter
item.description: In the absence of an investor day this year, Josh Kushner wrote his first formal letter to backers for his investment firm Thrive.

item.title: Japan Stocks Headed for Best Weekly Rise Since June on AI Gains
item.description: Japanese stocks are headed for their best weekly gain in about two months led by a tech rally after US wholesale inflation decelerated, easing concerns about immediate interest-rate increases by the Federal Reserve.

item.title: India Bar Council Retreats After ‘Cockroach’ Protest Threat
item.description: India’s national regulator for lawyers reversed an order barring an entire graduating class at one of the country’s leading law schools from enrolling as advocates, hours after the move triggered threats of protests from a fast-growing youth movement.

item.title: CXMT’s Absence Leaves CSI 300 Missing China’s Biggest Stock
item.description: China’s CSI 300 Index risks losing its appeal as the nation’s key benchmark until it includes memory giant CXMT Corp., an event that’s unlikely to happen until the end of 2027, according to Bloomberg Intelligence.

item.title: Carry Traders Exploit Intervention to Rebuild Yen Shorts
item.description: Every intervention to prop up the yen is also creating a fresh opportunity to sell it.

item.title: New Zealand Immigration Edges to 17-Month High Yet Remains Weak
item.description: New Zealand annual immigration continues to show signs of a tentative recovery, rising to a 17-month high in June as fewer people departed.

item.title: Gold Steadies as Traders Weigh Fed Rate Path and Mideast Tension
item.description: Gold was little changed after retreating below $4,400 an ounce, as traders weighed the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate path and prospects for a deal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Peru Keeps 4.25% Rate as Inflation Pick-Up Seen as Temporary
item.description: Peru held borrowing costs unchanged for a 11th month on Thursday as policymakers gauge that the recent run-up in consumer prices will be temporary.

item.title: Cloudy Yen Outlook Raises the Bar for Japan’s Earnings Beats
item.description: The risk that Japan takes more steps to bolster the yen is taking some of the shine off corporate earnings, as investors weigh the impact of any turnaround in the currency on exporters’ profits.

item.title: Asian Stocks Set for Gains as US Inflation Cools: Markets Wrap
item.description: Asian stocks were poised to extend gains Friday as further evidence of moderating US inflation and a pullback in oil prices reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising interest rates next month.

item.title: Reddit Shares Surge on S&P 500 Inclusion Later This Month
item.description: Reddit Inc. will join the S&P 500 next week as part of an off-cycle change, S&P Dow Jones Indices said Thursday, sending the social networking platform’s shares surging more than 10% after the bell.

item.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Aug. 14
item.description: Oil held a decline as traders monitored efforts toward a deal that could reopen the Strait of Hormuz, while more attacks on tankers and energy infrastructure kept the market on edge.

item.title: SEC Delays Crypto Regulation Meeting in Latest Industry Setback
item.description: The Securities and Exchange Commission canceled a Friday meeting where the agency was expected to unveil new plans for digital assets as landmark crypto legislation remains stalled in Congress.

item.title: Judge Orders Kalshi to Stop Offering Most Wagers in Washington
item.description: Kalshi was told by a judge to stop offering most of its prediction market contracts in Washington state, after regulators said they likely constituted an illegal gambling operation.

item.title: OpenAI’s Revenue Run Rate Tops $40 Billion Ahead of IPO
item.description: OpenAI is on track to generate annualized revenue of more than $40 billion based on its current performance, according to people familiar with the matter, roughly doubling its run rate from the end of 2025 and bolstering the company’s plans for a Wall Street debut.

item.title: Why It’s So Hard to Measure the Economy’s Real Potential
item.description: It’s tough to measure the economy’s true potential

item.title: Winklevosses’ Gemini Posts Another Loss, Revenue Increases
item.description: Gemini Space Station Inc., the digital-asset platform led by the billionaires Tyler and Cameron Winklevoss that went public last year just before the crypto market tumbled from record highs, posted a fourth consecutive quarterly loss since the IPO.

item.title: Apple App Store Commission-Rate Proceedings Can Move Forward
item.description: Apple Inc. must take part in a lower court proceeding over the rate it charges developers for sales outside its App Store after the Supreme Court rejected a bid by the iPhone-maker to pause all further action in the case.

item.title: UAE, Qatari Firms Debut in Venezuela Through BP-Led Gas Deal
item.description: Arab Gulf companies are making their debut in Venezuela through an offshore natural gas project to be operated by BP Plc.

item.title: Applied Materials Forecast Gets Tepid Reaction After Rally
item.description: Applied Materials Inc. delivered an estimate-beating forecast that still got a lukewarm reaction from investors, a sign of the lofty hopes surrounding a company that’s key to the AI boom.

item.title: Tyson to Close More Beef Plants as US Cattle Shortage Drags On
item.description: Tyson Foods Inc. said it would close several additional beef plants, in the latest sign of the US beefpacking industry’s restructuring amid a prolonged US cattle shortage.

item.title: OpenAI, Anthropic Tout New Metric to Better Gauge AI’s Cost
item.description: The AI firms want customers to rethink the price of using their models.

item.title: Diversified Said to Near Deal for Elliott-Backed Birch
item.description: Diversified Energy Co. is in advanced talks to acquire Elliott Investment Management-backed oil and gas company Birch Resources for more than $1.7 billion in cash, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: NYC Pied-a-Terre Tax Can Proceed for Now, Appeals Court Says
item.description: The rollout of New York’s pied-à-terre tax can proceed for now after an appeals court temporarily put a hold on a Staten Island judge’s order blocking the plan.
